summary: FIX VERIFICATION for iter_final DO_NOT_DEPLOY blocker (ffmpeg missing). Confirmed ffmpeg 5.1.9 + ffprobe + DejaVu fonts are now installed. Re-ran the 7 previously-failing ffmpeg-related tests plus the full 56-test pair (test_iter10_ffmpeg_and_video_missing.py + test_iter_final_prelaunch.py) — 56/56 PASSED. Also executed a synthetic ffmpeg compose smoke test (color+sine+drawtext -> mp4) confirming the full h264/aac/drawtext pipeline works end-to-end in this container.

deployment_notes: PRODUCTION deployment container (managed by Emergent platform) may or may not have ffmpeg pre-installed — this is a platform-level concern outside the code repo.

Recommended post-deploy verification: (a) call /api/health if it exposes ffmpeg status, or (b) issue a single test video-generation request against the deployed URL and confirm the video renders without a 'FFmpeg not installed on server' error.
The RuntimeError guard at server.py:1020-1021 will fail LOUD (500 with clear message) if the production container lacks ffmpeg — this is safe fail-fast behavior, not silent corruption.
action_items: OPTIONAL (nice-to-have, non-blocking): expose ffmpeg availability in /api/health response so deploy verification is a single curl.
OPTIONAL (tech debt): migrate FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown -> lifespan context manager to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::_ffmpeg_compose_all guard is well-implemented — fails fast with actionable install command in error message.
No hardcoded ffmpeg paths in code — relies on PATH via shutil.which/subprocess, which is portable.

DejaVu font path in drawtext filter is hardcoded to /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf (verified present); acceptable for the target Debian container but worth noting if platform changes.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: previous container image did not include ffmpeg apt package. FIX: main agent ran `apt-get install -y ffmpeg fonts-dejavu-core` which installed ffmpeg 5.1.9-0+deb12u1 (and ffprobe via same package) plus DejaVu font family required by the drawtext subtitle overlay filter. VERIFICATION: shutil.which('ffmpeg') now returns /usr/bin/ffmpeg from the backend Python context; the guard at server.py:1020 no longer raises; synthetic compose smoke test proves the h264/aac/drawtext pipeline is fully operational. MITIGATION FOR PROD: the fail-fast RuntimeError guard ensures that if the production container ever lacks ffmpeg, users see a clear 500 error message instead of silent partial failures — a post-deploy smoke test is still recommended.
